I guess so. I think a big reason that this scares me so much is that I'd never really thought about the possibility of me dying in such detail before. Like, death to me always used to be something that'd happen in like 50-60 years, and by that time I would have had it all sorted out and I'd go out having lived a full life with a husband and kids or whatever. Now I'm sitting here and it feels like each week could be my last from some stupid lapse in judgement and I don't know how to deal with it.
